title: Invoice Hands
subtitle: It collects your supplier invoices from their portals, so you never log in to download a PDF again.
forWhom: for freelancers with a dozen suppliers
intro: Three episodes: a portal added, the agent fetching the invoices, the list you hand to your accountant.

setup.name: What was set up
setup.text: A demo account with three invented supplier portals and their demo logins. No real data.

agent.name: What the agent does
agent.text: It signs in to each portal in a real browser, finds the new invoices and downloads them. You decide what gets paid.

episodes.title: Add a portal
episodes.situation: You have just signed in; no portal is connected yet.

steps.do: Pick « Example Energy » and paste the demo login.

episodes.title: The agent fetches the invoices
episodes.situation: One portal is connected and holds three invoices you have not downloaded.

steps.do: Say « fetch my invoices » into the microphone button.
steps.see: The agent's live view: a browser signing in to the portal.
Three invoices appear in « Invoices », each named by supplier and month.

episodes.title: Hand them to the accountant
episodes.situation: The month's invoices are in the list.

steps.do: Open « Invoices » and tick the three of September.
steps.see: The three rows selected, « Export » enabled.
A zip with the three PDFs.

closing.title: What comes next
closing.text: A monthly run without asking, and the export sent straight to the accountant.
